Prices are announced on the last day of each month, take effect on the first, and include VAT. This page is updated with every announcement.

How to work out your fuel cost

Full tank = tank size × price per litre. Monthly cost = (monthly distance × litres per 100 km ÷ 100) × price per litre. A car driving 2,000 km a month at 8 litres per 100 km needs 160 litres, or AED 646.40 with Special 95 in November 2026.

Frequently asked questions

What are UAE petrol prices for November 2026?

Super 98 is AED 4.16 a litre, Special 95 AED 4.04, E-Plus 91 AED 3.97 and diesel AED 4.75, down 5.6% for petrol and 1.04% for diesel from October.

When are UAE fuel prices announced?

The Fuel Price Committee announces them on the last day of each month, effective from the first of the next month, following average global prices.

How much does a 60-litre tank cost this month?

AED 242.40 with Special 95, AED 249.60 with Super 98, AED 238.20 with E-Plus 91 and AED 285 with diesel.

Do the prices include VAT?

Retail prices are announced including 5% VAT; it is the price you pay at the pump.
